Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AMU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AMU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AMU Assistant Professor Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: First Class Bachelor's Degree in Fashion / Garment Technology, preferably from NIFT or its Equivalent OR A Master's Degree in any subject with First Class Diploma in Costume Design & Dress Making / Garment Technology / Fashion Design of two years' duration after SSSC / three years' duration after SSC or its equivalent with 5 years' experience in the relevant field

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) for various positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Assistant Professor (Contractual).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this AMU recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts through online mode.

faq.question: Q5. What are the important dates for application?
faq.answer: The online application starts on 08 August 2026, and the last date to apply is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First Class Bachelor's Degree in Fashion/Garment Technology or a Master's Degree with a First Class Diploma in Costume Design & Dress Making/Garment Technology/Fashion Design with 5 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC/SC/ST categories, while PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Assistant Professor (Contractual) at AMU?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts primarily involves a Local Selection Committee Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The job location for this position is Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official website to apply and find more details is https://careers.amuonline.ac.in.
